newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN to cut off-peak electricity prices.
newsitem.headline: EVN to cut off-peak electricity prices.

text.p: Lower Austrian regional utility Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich AG (EVN) said on Friday it would cut off-peak electricity prices from January 1, 1997.
In a statement EVN said the move would pass on to customers advantages gained from increased efficiency and encourage the use of more hydro electricity.
Big industrial and public customers would benefit under the plan, EVN said. The extent of the price reduction would vary according to electricity use patterns.
Off-peak tariffs to smaller customers would fall eight percent to 0.78 schilling per kiloWatt hour. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
